Strings.tailscale.peers_restricted: Tailnet device list requires host network authorization.
Strings.tailscale.title: Tailscale Manager
Strings.tailscale.error: The operation failed. Try again later.
Strings.tailscale.auto_refresh_failed: Automatic refresh failed. Showing the previous result.
Strings.tailscale.control_loading: Reading the host connection and settings…
Strings.tailscale.control_unavailable: Host controls are unavailable. Refresh the current state.
Strings.tailscale.accept_dns_hint: Uses the DNS configuration provided by Tailscale. Disabling it may prevent tailnet names from resolving.
Strings.tailscale.accept_routes_hint: Accepts subnet routes advertised by other devices. Disabling it may make those subnets unreachable.
Strings.tailscale.preferences_hint: Switches reflect the host's last observed preferences. Each change is reviewed and confirmed first.
Strings.tailscale.preferences_unavailable: Read the connection state before changing preferences.
Strings.tailscale.boundary_note: This manager runs only fixed official CLI actions (connect, disconnect, accept DNS, accept routes). Signing out, login keys and arbitrary arguments are not supported.
Strings.tailscale.operations_intro: Recent operation IDs are kept on this device per host and account. Selecting one reads the original server receipt automatically; a lost response does not mean the change failed.
Strings.tailscale.operation_empty: Select an operation and read its receipt.
Strings.tailscale.awaiting_receipt: The change may have been submitted. Reopen this operation to verify its original receipt.
Strings.tailscale.operation_applied: Change applied; host state was read again.
Strings.tailscale.session_changed: The host or login changed. Reading the new state.
Strings.tailscale.network_risk: This change may interrupt remote access, DNS or routing, including this session. Ensure another way to reach the host. There is no automatic rollback.
Strings.tailscale.operation_state.Applying: Applying; read the original receipt again.
Strings.tailscale.operation_state.Applied: Applied and verified by the host.
Strings.tailscale.operation_state.Unknown: Outcome unknown. Do not repeat the change; inspect the original operation.
Strings.tailscale.login_required: Sign in to Tailscale on the host before connecting.
Strings.tailscale.recovery_required: An unresolved host operation blocks changes. Read its original receipt, then inspect recovery state.
Strings.tailscale.plan_expired: The preview expired. Read the current state and prepare a new change.
Strings.tailscale.revision_conflict: The host state changed. Refresh and review the change again.
Strings.tailscale.idempotency_conflict: This operation ID belongs to a different request.
Strings.tailscale.operation.not_found: The original operation is unavailable for this host and account.
Strings.tailscale.operation.outcome_unknown: The host could not prove this operation completed. Read its original receipt before taking further action.
Strings.tailscale.operation.interrupted: The operation was interrupted; completion has not been verified.
Strings.tailscale.operation_reference_failed: The operation reference could not be saved. The change was not submitted.
Strings.tailscale.invalid_response: The host or server returned an unrecognized response.
Strings.tailscale.unauthenticated: The login has expired. Sign in again.
Strings.tailscale.confirmation_required: Review and confirm the change before executing.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.intro: For an unknown outcome, read the original receipt and inspect the host before accepting its current state.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.confirm_effect: Closing does not retry or roll back the original change and does not prove it succeeded. Its outcome remains unknown. You accept the observed state and allow new changes.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.observation: Observed connection: {0} · Accept DNS: {1} · Accept routes: {2}
Strings.tailscale.recovery.closed: Closed by operator; the original outcome remains unknown.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.awaiting_receipt: Closure may have been recorded. Reopen the original operation to verify.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.cli_active: A Tailscale command is still running. Wait for it to finish, then inspect again.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.observation_changed: The host observation changed. Inspect again before closing.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.not_ready: The host is not ready for closure. Inspect its current state again.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.preview_required: Recovery inspection is missing or expired. Inspect again.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.state_invalid: Only unresolved operations with an unknown outcome can be closed.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.receipt_mismatch: The closure receipt does not match the original operation or account.
Strings.tailscale.recovery.unavailable: Recovery is unavailable. Reopen the original operation before trying again.
Strings.tailscale.login.title: First login
Strings.tailscale.login.intro: Start the first Tailscale login on this server. After confirmation the official authentication page opens in this device's browser.
Strings.tailscale.login.start_and_open: Sign in and open the browser
Strings.tailscale.login.start_hint: After authorizing in the browser, return here to inspect the current state and close this login operation. Connection settings stay blocked until it is closed.
Strings.tailscale.login.need_login: This server needs to sign in to Tailscale.
Strings.tailscale.login.already_connected: This server is already signed in and connected; no first login is needed. To switch accounts, sign out of Tailscale on the host first.
Strings.tailscale.login.already_stopped: This server is signed in but currently disconnected. Reconnect from Connection and settings.
Strings.tailscale.login.device_approval: This device is waiting for approval in the Tailscale admin console. It will show as connected once approved.
Strings.tailscale.login.status_unknown: Reading the host state; it is checked again before login starts.
Strings.tailscale.login.completed_detected: Browser authorization completed. Inspect the current state and close this login operation.
Strings.tailscale.login.finish_hint: Closing accepts the observed state; it never replays the login or rolls back a change.
Strings.tailscale.login.records: Login operations for this server and account; challenges require the original login session.
Strings.tailscale.login.waiting_boundary: Closing this window stops waiting. It does not revoke a login challenge on the server.
Strings.tailscale.login.start_risk: This starts Tailscale on the selected server and may interrupt your remote connection. There is no automatic rollback. After confirmation the official authentication page opens in this device's browser. Cancelling later does not revoke an already issued challenge.
Strings.tailscale.login.close_risk: Accept the currently observed host state and release this login operation's pending-change block. This does not revoke the upstream login challenge, replay login, roll back changes or prove the original operation succeeded.
Strings.tailscale.login.closed: Closed by operator. The original login outcome is unchanged.
Strings.tailscale.login.browser_opened: The official authentication page was opened. Complete authorization there; this page detects completion automatically.
Strings.tailscale.login.browser_failed: The browser could not be opened. Read the original receipt before trying the browser handoff again.
Strings.tailscale.login.not_available: This host cannot start a first login now (already signed in, a challenge is pending, or Tailscale is unavailable). Refresh the state and try again.
Strings.tailscale.login.state_changed: The host login state changed. Refresh and try again.
Strings.tailscale.login.state_conflict: The login operation does not match the host state. Read its original receipt again.
Strings.tailscale.login.unavailable: The host login service is unavailable.
Strings.tailscale.login.challenge_unavailable: The authentication link can no longer be retrieved (it may have expired or belong to the original login session only).
Strings.tailscale.login.outcome_unknown: The login outcome is unknown. Inspect the original operation before closing it.
Strings.tailscale.login.state.Issued: Login challenge issued; authentication is not yet confirmed
Strings.tailscale.login.state.Unknown: Original outcome unknown; inspect before closing
